Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the birthplace information from the search results in the fourth step. In the first search for the birthplace ("František Filip místo narození"), the results clearly showed the birthplace as "Písek" on cs.wikipedia.org and ČSFD.cz. However, in the fourth step (and subsequent steps), the agent repeated the same search query and reported that the "birthplace has not yet been solidified" or "not yet fully corroborated," despite the visible text in the viewport explicitly stating "26. prosince 1930 Písek" and "spatřil poprvé světlo světa v Písku." The agent ignored the available evidence and unnecessarily continued searching with the same queries, failing to conclude the task based on the data already present.
